headline: Executive order sets up a White House office to work with faith-based and neighborhood groups.
what_it_does: This order creates the White House Office of Faith-Based and Neighborhood Partnerships. Based on its title, the office is meant to connect the federal government with religious groups and local community organizations. No summary was provided, so details about the office's duties, staff, or programs are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Religious organizations, such as churches, mosques, and synagogues
who_it_affects.how: They gain a specific White House office set up to work with faith-based groups.
They gain a White House office whose name points to partnerships with neighborhood groups.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 14, 2021; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
